completeness.why: All four sites now call getWeekendAdjustedDay, which decides both whether the rule applies (skipWeekend) and the mode; each site only maps its own fields (weekendSolve vs weekendSolveMode). getNextDate folds its site-only noSkipWeekend option into the flag it passes, which the rubric allows for a variation that exists only at that site, so it is scored full rather than partial.

interface.why: A day string plus {skipWeekend, weekendSolveMode} covers exactly the real variation with no speculative options and leaves the field-name mapping explicit at callers, but the string-in/string-out shape makes upcoming-dates convert Date to string and back, and the noSkipWeekend override is expressed only implicitly through the flag.

disguised_duplication.where: The four copies of the skipWeekend ternary are removed and getDateWithSkippedWeekend is made module-private; no reshaped copy remains.
